_comment: EXAMPLE MCP config for the PrimeNG -> (Angular Material | Optimus UI) migration. Servers split by target: (1) BOTH targets: primeng (OLD side), angular-cli (validation), tailwind (PrimeFlex->Tailwind). (2) Material target ONLY: ngm-dev-blocks (Material generator) — Optimus has NO MCP (it is an internal library with WebFetch-only docs). Gate 3 of ui-migration-rules requires the relevant servers present and reachable for the active target. Copy the relevant entries into the repo's .mcp.json (project-level) or ~/.claude.json (user-level).

_verified.primeng: @primeng/mcp is published on npm (verified 2026-11); its README documents `npx -y @primeng/mcp` as the public command and `claude mcp add primeng -- npx -y @primeng/mcp` for Claude Code
_verified.angular-cli: VERIFIED 2026-11 — `@angular/cli` ships a built-in `mcp` subcommand (`ng mcp`), so `npx -y @angular/cli mcp` is a valid stdio entry (NEW-side docs + build/devserver validation, BOTH targets). In a real project pass `--root <abs-path-to-project>`.
_verified.tailwind: Remote/URL MCP at https://mcp.tailwind.ai (Tailwind's official MCP, BOTH targets for PrimeFlex->Tailwind). Config is {"tailwind":{"url":"https://mcp.tailwind.ai"}} — a remote HTTP server, NOT an npx stdio entry. Verify at Gate 3 by listing mcp__tailwind__* tools. Companion skills: `npx @tailwind-app/skills`.
_verified.ngm-dev-blocks: Material target ONLY — VERIFIED 2026-11 — the dedicated Angular Material generator from ui.angular-material.dev/docs/mcp. `npx -y @ngm-dev/cli mcp <abs-project-dir>` exposes get-all-block-names / generate-angular-material-block / setup-angular-material-blocks. Complements angular-cli (generator writes the new Material+Tailwind code; angular-cli validates it). NOT used for the Optimus target.

primeng._comment: BOTH targets — PrimeNG MCP, audit the OLD PrimeNG usage (component API, template syntax, behavior). Exposes mcp__primeng__* tools (list, version, get_component, search, get_example, validate_usage).

angular-cli._comment: BOTH targets — NEW-side Angular docs + build/devserver VALIDATION (ng mcp). Verified: `@angular/cli` ships an `mcp` subcommand. In a real project add `--root <abs-project-dir>`. Exposes mcp__angular-cli__* (get_best_practices, search_documentation, list_projects, run_target, devserver_*).

tailwind._comment: BOTH targets — Tailwind MCP (official, Tailwind CSS docs + API lookups for the PrimeFlex->Tailwind swap, incl. the MANDATORY size-difference check). REMOTE/URL server (HTTP), not an npx stdio entry — no command/args. Verify at Gate 3 by listing mcp__tailwind__* tools. Companion skills (optional, separate from MCP): `npx @tailwind-app/skills`.

ngm-dev-blocks._comment: Material target ONLY (Optimus has NO MCP) — DEDICATED Angular Material MCP (ui.angular-material.dev/docs/mcp) — GENERATE new Material + Tailwind blocks. Verified: `@ngm-dev/cli mcp <dir>` exposes mcp__ngm-dev-blocks__* (setup-angular-material-blocks, generate-angular-material-block, get-all-block-names). Replace `full/path/to/angular/project` with the actual project dir before use. Complementary to angular-cli (which does docs + validation).
